text: Program Description Campus: Putuo Campus Program Duration: March 1st, 2027 - June 18th, 2027 (the first week is orientation week and classes start from March 8th, 2027). *16 weeks in total (the orientation week included). In case of Chinese public holidays and school activities, classes will be adjusted or suspended. *From December 28th, 2026, the school will notify admitted students by email in batches to complete the Chinese proficiency questionnaire and take an online placement interview. Please ensure that student email addresses are accurate and valid. Duration: one semester or more Class Schedule: 29 class hours per week (1 class hour = 45 minutes) Morning: From Monday to Friday 8:30-11:45 Afternoon: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday 13:15-15:45 Class opening conditions: Application Requirements: Classes are offered at levels from intermediate to advanced (Intermediate, Pre-Advanced, Advanced). Class Opening Conditions: Each level requires a minimum of 8 students to open. Textbook: A Practical Business Chinese Reader, Erya Chinese, Excel in Chinese, etc.It will be adjusted according to the actual situation. The cost of teaching materials is at your own expense. Course description Specially designed for those who will or have already engaged in business or trade career under Chinese-related background. Offer appropriate courses for students of different levels to meet their needs at different learning stages. Help students obtain a larger vocabulary and specialized knowledge of business purpose. Enhance students' understanding of contemporary Chinese economy and finance through diverse courses. Cultivate students' communication skills in business surroundings through various scenario simulations like negotiation, speech, etc. Regularly arrange business themed lectures and on-site visits to companies.
